transactionEvidence: Journal assertions cover upstream replacement, keep/pin, fork, exact reviewed removal, exact-force interruption, legacy migration, generated companions, manifest, lock, and every prior adoption/update report path.
A forced process exit after the first exact-force asset write preserved the journal and every backup; explicit recovery restored all 15 transaction targets byte-for-byte, including CRLF report bytes.

A legacy migration failure injected after the lock write but before the manifest write rolled back to manifest 1.0, removed the newly written lock, restored every prior report byte-for-byte, and recorded a rolled-back terminal journal.

Keep/pin leaves local content outside the mutation target set while journaling manifest, lock, and reports; fork journals canonical replacements plus missing fork destinations and generated help for rollback removal; exact removal journals the deleted asset backup.
implementationValidation.writeOrderEvidence: applyUpdate verifies candidate content, atomically writes project-orchestrator.lock.json, invokes the tested pre-manifest failure point, then atomically writes project-orchestrator.json; the legacy rollback fixture validates the intervening failure path.
